dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to have opinions concerning Kameras, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: Yes... and no. I think that Kameras are excellent, intricate creations that have provided untold convenience to many — of that, there can be no doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: But if you place Kameras in the field of making art, then their limitations become quite apparent.

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: People's imaginations, and the beauty and spirit in their hearts, cannot be directly seized from the natural world. Don't you think so too?
